label: Fleet Cockpit
description: ESP fleet surveillance overview across all 3 fields and 25 ESP wells with KPI cards, exception counters, and fleet table.

label: Well Directory
description: Fleet well list view directing users to select an individual well for telemetry and downhole monitoring.

label: Well Monitor
description: Single-well operational monitoring featuring downhole ESP schematic, electrical & hydraulic gauges, pressure profile, and Advisor panel.

label: Exceptions
description: Operational exception and opportunity triage queue detailing wells in critical/warning states (gas lock, pump wear, VSD trips).

label: Troubleshooting
description: Guided ESP diagnostics tool with interactive decision trees, VSD trip code lookup, and recommended action steps.

label: Reliability
description: Run life statistics, MTBF metrics, bad actors ranking, teardown failure mode findings, and intervention planning.

label: Reports
description: Executive scorecards, weekly field performance summaries, deferment analysis, and printable operational reports.

label: Engineering Home
description: Overview of governed ESP master data, catalog equipment, installed assemblies, and calculation-grade governance.

label: Equipment Catalog
description: Master catalog of OEM pumps, motors, protectors, gas separators, and cables with digitized performance curves.

label: Pump Model Specification
description: Detailed OEM pump model specs, digitized head/power/efficiency data points, and operating range limits.

label: Installed Fleet
description: Installed ESP systems list showing equipment assemblies, pump stages, motor HP ratings, and installation dates.

label: Installation Detail
description: Full downhole string assembly detail, fluid properties, well trajectory limits, and calculation-grade readiness check.

label: Well Definition
description: Per-well governed revisions, provenance contract tracking, and OT tag dictionary mappings.

label: Governance Validation
description: Assembly calculation-grade validation matrix (A1-D classification), missing tag checks, and curve digitization audits.

label: Engineering Workbench
description: Interactive curve plotting, TDH vs Pump Head calculations, BEP/ROR evaluation, and frequency scenario modeling.

label: Design Cases
description: ESP design case vs actual operating point comparisons across initial, present, and future reservoir conditions.

label: Administration
description: Platform integration settings for OTConnex, Asset ConneX, alarm rule thresholds, and user access roles.
